title: The Value of Spike Timing: A Leakage-Resistant Benchmark of SNN Design Choices for Network Intrusion Detection
abstract: arXiv:2606.01442v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are increasingly studied for network intrusion detection, but comparative evidence on how neuron models and spike encodings affect performance remains limited. Evaluation choices can influence results when preprocessing, capture structure, or scenario information crosses the train--test boundary. We evaluate nine snnTorch neuron families with three spike encodings, yielding 27 SNN configurations across four intrusion-detection benchmarks. We screen the design space and then repeat the evaluation using train-only transforms, seed-independent partitions, and capture- or scenario-aware separation. In our study, LeakyParallel/latency ranked first in both 27-configuration evaluations. translated_title: 脉冲时间的价值：面向网络入侵检测的抗泄漏SNN设计选择基准测试
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）在网络入侵检测领域的研究日益增多，但关于神经元模型和脉冲编码如何影响性能的比较性证据仍然有限。当预处理、捕获结构或场景信息跨越训练-测试边界时，评估方式的选择可能会影响结果。我们在四个入侵检测基准数据集上，对九种snntorch神经元家族与三种脉冲编码进行组合评估，共产生27种SNN配置。我们首先对该设计空间进行筛选，然后采用仅训练集变换、与随机种子无关的数据划分以及基于捕获或场景感知的分离方式重复评估。研究结果显示，LeakyParallel/latency配置在两次27配置评估中均排名第一；筛选阶段确定的主要配置在确认阶段也基本保持一致，这表明即使测量的性能（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个抗数据泄漏的SNN评估基准，系统比较了27种神经元模型与脉冲编码组合在网络入侵检测任务中的表现，发现LeakyParallel/latency配置表现最佳，且证明初步筛选所得的设计排序在严格防泄漏评估下依然可靠。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a leakage-resistant benchmark systematically evaluating 27 SNN configurations (nine neuron families combined with three spike encodings) for network intrusion detection, showing that LeakyParallel/latency ranks first and that rankings from initial screening remain consistent under rigorous leakage-resistant evaluation.
